import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(15, 12))
fig.suptitle('Dog Registration Data Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# 1. Distribution of dog owners by age group
age_counts = df.groupby('AlterV10Lang')['HID'].nunique().sort_index()
axes[0, 0].bar(range(len(age_counts)), age_counts.values, color='skyblue', edgecolor='black')
axes[0, 0].set_xticks(range(len(age_counts)))
axes[0, 0].set_xticklabels(age_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right')
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Age Group', fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Number of Owners', fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_title('Dog Owners by Age Group')
axes[0, 0].grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 2. Distribution of dogs by district (Kreis)
kreis_counts = df.groupby('KreisLang')['AnzHunde'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
axes[0, 1].barh(range(len(kreis_counts)), kreis_counts.values, color='lightcoral', edgecolor='black')
axes[0, 1].set_yticks(range(len(kreis_counts)))
axes[0, 1].set_yticklabels(kreis_counts.index)
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Number of Dogs', fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('District', fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_title('Dogs by District')
axes[0, 1].grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

# 3. Dog age distribution
dog_age_counts = df.groupby('AlterVHundLang')['AnzHunde'].sum().sort_values()
axes[1, 0].bar(range(len(dog_age_counts)), dog_age_counts.values, color='lightgreen', edgecolor='black')
axes[1, 0].set_xticks(range(len(dog_age_counts)))
axes[1, 0].set_xticklabels(dog_age_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right')
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Dog Age', fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Number of Dogs', fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 0].set_title('Dogs by Age')
axes[1, 0].grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 4. Top dog breeds
breed_counts = pd.concat([
    df[df['Rasse1Text'].notna()]['Rasse1Text'],
    df[df['Rasse2Text'].notna()]['Rasse2Text']
]).value_counts().head(10)
axes[1, 1].barh(range(len(breed_counts)), breed_counts.values, color='plum', edgecolor='black')
axes[1, 1].set_yticks(range(len(breed_counts)))
axes[1, 1].set_yticklabels(breed_counts.index)
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Count', fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Breed', fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_title('Top 10 Dog Breeds')
axes[1, 1].grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
